## FreeBSD arm64 build

0.5.0 shipped without its FreeBSD arm64 archive: `route_manager` (pulled in by `tun-rs` on every BSD) does not compile for FreeBSD arm64, where `c_char` is unsigned. nqvpn has no TUN or route backend on FreeBSD, so neither crate is built there any more; the OS backends are now compiled only on Linux and macOS, where they are used.

No other changes: behaviour on Linux and macOS is identical to 0.5.0, and 0.5.1 interoperates with 0.3.x–0.5.0 members. If you run 0.5.0 on Linux or macOS there is no need to update, though `--self-update` will offer it.

| OS | amd64 | arm64 |
|---|---|---|
| Linux (static musl) | `nqvpn-0.5.1-linux-amd64.tar.gz` | `nqvpn-0.5.1-linux-arm64.tar.gz` |
| macOS | `nqvpn-0.5.1-macos-amd64.tar.gz` | `nqvpn-0.5.1-macos-arm64.tar.gz` |
| FreeBSD | `nqvpn-0.5.1-freebsd-amd64.tar.gz` | `nqvpn-0.5.1-freebsd-arm64.tar.gz` |
